root.label: IEA agrees coordinated strategic oil reserve release

events.label: IEA agrees coordinated strategic oil reserve release

slots.name: reserve release barrels
slots.sentence: The 32-member IEA agreed in March to a coordinated the release of 400 million barrels of strategic oil reserves, in response to disruption to supplies caused by the Iran war, the largest such release in history.

events.label: IEA says some March reserve release remains unreleased September 29 2026
